title: Open Values Node Preview Matrix v0.1
description: A list of test scenarios for a private preview of the app, grouped and in the order to run them, with what each must show. The data build writes it for testers. It is an internal file used while building the site.

format.description: Names this file's format, so a reader can check it before reading the rest of the file.

version.description: The version of the format this file follows, such as "0.1".

built.description: The date of the source data this file was built from, as YYYY-MM-DD.

source.description: The script and files this file was built from, as paths in the repository.

purpose.description: One sentence on what this file is for.

appLaneNote.description: A note on which choices this file leaves to the app code that reads it, such as fetching, layout and wording.

status.description: Always "pending-app-integration": the generated data is ready, and the app work that uses it is not yet confirmed.

h4DrainableFromDataAlone.description: Always false. The generated files alone can never close handoff item H4; that needs evidence from the running app.

groups.description: The scenario group ids, in the order they should be run.

runContract.description: The order to run the groups in, the evidence each needs, and when the run is done.

scenarios.description: The test scenarios for a private preview of the app.

totals.description: How many scenarios there are, overall and by group.

id.description: A short id for the scenario, such as "startup-nestle-concern".

group.description: The id of the group the scenario belongs to.

title.description: A one-line name for the scenario.

owner.description: Who owns this work. Always "app/design", the app and design side of the project.

sourceFiles.description: The generated files the scenario uses.

steps.description: What the tester does, in order.

acceptanceCriteria.description: What the tester must see for the scenario to pass, one sentence each.

mustNot.description: Things the app must not do here, one sentence each.

purpose.description: One sentence on what the run plan is for.

status.description: Always "pending-app-integration": the generated data is ready, and the app work that uses it is not yet confirmed.

h4DrainableFromDataAlone.description: Always false. The generated files alone can never close handoff item H4; that needs evidence from the running app.

namedConsumer.description: The piece of app work that uses this run plan.

drainRule.description: The rule for closing H4 from this run, in one sentence.

evidenceRequired.description: Evidence the run must produce, one sentence each.

runOrder.description: The groups in the order they should be run.

exitCriteria.description: Conditions that must all hold for the run to count as done.

coverage.description: Counts showing that every scenario and group is in the run order, and which scenario is the final decision.

step.description: The group's place in the run order, counting from 1.

group.description: The id of the group run at this step.

scenarioIds.description: The ids of the scenarios in this group.

passWhen.description: Conditions that must all hold for this group to pass.

mustNot.description: Things the app must not do here, one sentence each.
